title: .NET reading: background decompression
dataset: 1,000,000 rows × 10 columns, written by the Hypaxel writer with inline or shared strings, read cell by cell
method: XlsxReaderOptions.BackgroundDecompression measured interleaved with the default on the same files.
notes: With several readers at once on the 10 cores (inline file), the total time is 0.80–0.84 s by default and 0.56–0.59 s with it for 4 readers, but 1.14–1.15 s and 1.54–1.56 s for 10 readers.

It saves about 30% of the time when cores are idle but costs about 20% more CPU; when every core is busy it makes the total slower, which is why it is off by default. Each open worksheet holds 1 MiB of buffers (four 256 KiB chunks) while it is on.
reproduce:
cd dotnet/benchmarks/Hypaxel.Benchmarks
dotnet run -c Release -f net10.0 -- --read-quick 1000000                    # all readers, both files
dotnet run -c Release -f net10.0 -- --read-quick 1000000 Sylvan shared      # one reader, one file
